notes.title: Added Support for Chinese and Russian Languages!
notes.content:
We're so happy to announce that with the help of some amazing translators we were able to bring all of Playback Trauma: In Sickness to new languages (~17,000 words!!).  I want to personally thank the translators responsible, without you this never would've happened:

Russian - Kateryfied
Simplified/Traditional Chinese - Horace Pan

The game has also received a permanent price reduction to $4.99 USD

I want to thank you those who have experienced Playback Trauma and continue to do so, there's so much more to come!!

- Jonathan
